correctness.rationale: The three inverse branches of the explicit map g give L=(0 A;B 0) on two polynomial halves; A is invertible reflection and ABf(y)=[f(1/4-y/2)+f(1/4+y/2)]/2. AB has image the even polynomial space of dimension floor(d/2)+1; triangular filtration has distinct nonzero eigenvalues 4^-k, hence zero is semisimple for AB. Similarity of BA and AB and rank L=(d+1)+(floor(d/2)+1) give precisely ceil(d/2) size-two Jordan blocks at zero, and simple ±2^-k nonzero eigenvalues. The exact second transferred centered coordinate φ gives L²φ=(-1/4,1/4), a -1 eigenmode; C0=1/12, C1=-7/96, Cn=(-1)^n/16 for n≥2. A separately constructed exact SymPy transfer-matrix implementation reproduced charpolys and ranks for every d=0,...,7. The proof, not these finite degrees, establishes all d and all polynomial-pair correlations.
